title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I travel to several countries. Today, in lunch, we had asked for a seafood pizza. i was very clear that there should not be any meat (as i am halal conscious). When i had a first or the second bite, i got a piece of salami (pork). i immediately stopped eating the food. I asked for allahs forgiveness and prayed. What should i do. I am feeling extremely bad and guilty. i dont know if i have eaten the salami (port piece). kindly guide. 2774 views Q. Can I drink Red Bull that is energy drink? 4095 views Q. So is I am allowed to work in the Superstores or in restaurants like dat? 2854 views Q. Jazakumullah Khair 2344 views Q. Brazil Checken 2805 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 23229 Country: India Title: This is farooq, After eating camel meet and after drinking camel milk we have to do gusul compulsary? Question: This is farooq, After eating camel meet and after drinking camel milk we have to do gusul compulsary? Answer ID: 23229 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1177/941/B=1431) It is not necessary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
